notes.title: Nominate Timothy and the Tower of Mu for the Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[i]Timothy and the Tower of Mu[/i] has been released only around 3 months ago, but we would truly appreciate it if we could have your nomination for the "Best Game You Suck At" category at the upcoming Steam Awards!

With its instant-death traps, hardcore boss fights, and its demand for absolute precision in every move you make, the game is built upon the concept of "dying and learning". Only those with persistent enough can ascend to the top of the Tower of Mu.

The Tower of Mu itself is also made up of multiple unforgiving biomes, each populated with a variety of enemies that will test your skills to the limit. The faint-hearted won't stand a chance.

Steam defines this category as "the game that rewards persistence, and is not for the faint of heart", and we couldn't think of a more suitable nomination than [i]Timothy and the Tower of Mu[/i].

Thank you to everyone who has supported the game throughout and we look forward to having your vote at the Steam Awards!

notes.title: Update & OST Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I hope you're enjoying the many challenges in Timothy and the Tower of Mu!
We've got a lot of amazing news to share with you today, so please bear with us!

[h1][b]Game Update[/b][/h1]
The developers have been been hard at work to improve the game, taking into consideration everybody's valuable feedback.

While they couldn't take every single feedback on board, they've implemented the following fixes/changes that we believe would give all players an even greater experience playing the game.

[list]
[*]Players now gain a short period of invincibility after saving at a save point
[*]Optimized platform positions 
[*]Enemy drops for cooking ingredients/coins increased considerably
[*]Platinum coin (worth 10 coins) added as drop
[*]Fixed jumping bug during dialogues
[*]Balanced cooking ingredients cost 
[*]Fixed certain enemy AI
[*]Balanced the consumable items cost 
[*]Text improvements/fixes
[/list]
Again, we want to thank you all for your feedback on the game, we truly appreciate it and hope that you will continue helping us improve the game further.

[h1][b]Original Soundtrack[/b][/h1] 
We're also really excited to announce that the original soundtrack for the game, with a whopping 39 tracks, is now available for purchase on Steam! Get it together with the game in a bundle to save 10% off the combined price. If you already have the game, you'll still get the soundtrack at 10% off, so don't worry about missing out!

The chiptune music from the game will surely make a strong impression on you. Now you can enjoy these  amazing tunes whenever and wherever you like! Perhaps to get you hyped up for a hardcore session of study or work?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2130350/

[h1][b]Steam Scream Fest[/b][/h1]
We're really happy to be a part of the Steam Scream Fest, which means that you can now get the game for 20% off full price until 11/1 PT!

The game's never been more affordable than this so this is the perfect opportunity to add some hardcore platforming action to your life this Halloween season. If you already own the game, you could help us spread the word and get more fans onboard!

notes.title: Timothy and the Tower of Mu releasing on August 9th!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Timothy and the Tower of Mu is a retro 2D Action Platformer that combines classic action elements with beautiful pixel art and hardcore difficulty, promising to give players an unforgiving challenge.
The release date is set for August 9, 2022 so please stay tuned!
For a sneak peek of what you can expect, have a go at the demo on Steam today!

Game Features
[list]
[*] 10-hour campaign filled with secrets to uncover and five themed-dungeons!
[*] NES-inspired retro graphics with detailed animations and varying environment/landscapes.
[*] Classic action platformer mechanics - easy to learn but hard to master
[*] RPG, puzzles, and cooking elements aimed to keep the experience fresh and varied.
[*] Engaging chiptune-style soundtrack
[*] Push yourself beyond your limits and learn from your mistakes!
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1695260/

notes.title: Pixel Game Maker MV Contest Winner Timothy and the Tower of Mu Releasing in 2022
notes.notes:

Timothy and the Tower of Mu was chosen as the PLAYISM Prize Winner in the 2020 edition of the PGMMV Game Development Challenge. It combines classic action elements with beautiful pixel art and hardcore difficulty, promising to give players an unforgiving challenge.
The demo is available for all now during Steam Next Festival until 7th October, check it out for a taste of what is to come!

The full version will be coming in 2022, so add it to your wishlist today!
